description: Election Commission - Declare that P. Ramakrishnan as a member of the Vavuniya South Tamil Pradeshiya Sabha

The content specifically deals with the electoral process under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination of a new member by a recognized political party and the official declaration of the elected member.
